auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Autoblogging.ai API key sent in the JSON request body. Manage keys in the API Keys section of your Autoblogging.ai dashboard: https://dash.autoblogging.ai/

extraFields.label: Dashboard Email
extraFields.description: The email address for your Autoblogging.ai dashboard account. It is required with the API key for every official API request: https://autoblogging.ai/api-documentation/

actions.name: create_article
actions.description: Create an Autoblogging.ai article generation job and return the article ID plus credit metadata.

title.description: The meaningful and descriptive title for the article.

project_name.description: Optional Autoblogging.ai project name used for organization.

language.description: The language for the generated article.

writing_style.description: Writing style to use for the article.

faqs.description: Whether this Autoblogging.ai option is enabled.

imagegeneration.description: Whether to generate images for the article. This costs one extra credit when enabled.

godlikemode.description: Whether to use enhanced article quality. This costs one extra credit when enabled.

serp_location.description: Two-letter country code for SERP analysis, such as us, uk, or de.

outlinefromcompetition.description: Whether this Autoblogging.ai option is enabled.

keytakeaways.description: Whether this Autoblogging.ai option is enabled.

externallinks.description: Whether this Autoblogging.ai option is enabled.

videoembed.description: Whether this Autoblogging.ai option is enabled.

source_context.description: Additional context for article generation. Use na when no source context is needed.

wordpresspush.description: Whether this Autoblogging.ai option is enabled.

wp_siteurl.description: WordPress site URL when wordpresspush is yes.

wp_username.description: WordPress username when wordpresspush is yes.

wp_password.description: WordPress password when wordpresspush is yes.

wp_category.description: WordPress category name when wordpresspush is yes.

wp_status.description: WordPress post status when wordpresspush is yes.

wp_customtext.description: Custom WordPress text, or na when unused.

applyautogenerateslugs.description: Whether this Autoblogging.ai option is enabled.

applyautogeneratetitles.description: Whether this Autoblogging.ai option is enabled.

combotpush.description: Whether this Autoblogging.ai option is enabled.

combot_triggerid.description: ComBot trigger ID, or na when unused.

intense_optimize.description: Whether this Autoblogging.ai option is enabled.

ai_proofreader.description: Whether to use AI proofreading. This costs one extra credit when enabled.

proofreading_guidelines.description: Proofreading guidelines when ai_proofreader is yes, or na when unused.

infographics.description: Whether to generate infographics. This costs one extra credit when enabled.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for creating an Autoblogging.ai article generation job.

article_id.description: Article ID token to pass to fetch_article.

credits_used.description: Credits consumed by the creation request.

credits_remaining.description: Credits remaining after the creation request.

actions.name: fetch_article
actions.description: Fetch an Autoblogging.ai article generation job by article ID and return pending, completed, or failed status.

url_token.description: Article ID token returned by create_article.

message.description: Status message when the article is still being generated.

final_title.description: Final generated article title when the article is completed.

final_article.description: Final generated article content when the article is completed.

error_message.description: Failure reason when article generation failed.

outputSchema.description: Autoblogging.ai article generation status and completed content when available.
